The Missing Person Report: A husband files a missing complaint after his wife, working at a local clothing store, fails to return from her lunch break.

CCTV Footages Clues: Police review security cameras, revealing the victim arriving at a Krishna Lanka lodge on her scooty and meeting a man.

The Suspicious Departure: The suspect is seen leaving the lodge hurriedly about 30 minutes later, taking her vehicle and dropping it near a bus stand before escaping.

The Shocking Discovery: Following the victim's phone location and lodge records, police break open the room to find her lifeless body on the bed.

Pre-Planned Execution: Investigation reveals the suspect, hailing from Srikakulam, had booked the lodge room a day prior, pointing towards a pre-planned act.

Social Media Angle: Initial suspicions point toward an acquaintance formed through social media, as authorities launch a nationwide hunt to capture the fugitive within 24 hours.

recentItems.description:
#AndhraPradesh, #CycloneAlert, #AquanCyclone, #APWeather, #BayOfBengal, #iDreamNews, #APFloods, #TeluguNews, #WeatherUpdate, #CoastalAndhra,
AP ని వణికించనున్న మరో పెను తుఫాను..|  Aquan cyclone alert | AP weather update 2026 | iDream

New Cyclone Alert ("Aquan"): Meteorological departments indicate that a new weather system / low-pressure area is likely to form in the Bay of Bengal between November 9 and November 15, threatening to intensify into a severe cyclone named "Aquan."

Expected Path and Affected Regions: If the system strengthens into a cyclone, it is projected to move towards Nellore, Tirupati, and northern Tamil Nadu, potentially bringing heavy to very heavy rains across coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema districts.

Massive Financial and Material Loss: Previous cyclones caused extensive damages—including uprooted 100-to-150-year-old trees, broken electricity poles (with 1,000 poles specially sourced from Chennai), destroyed crops, and preliminary government estimates peg the total losses at around ₹1,200 crores.

Government Preparedness and Relief: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu and Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewed the situation, and local administrative machinery remains on high alert to evacuate low-lying areas, assist fishermen, and ensure zero loss of human life.

Uncertainty and Waiting Period: Weather officials note that while conditions favor a system formation, it could either dissipate or intensify, with complete clarity expected within the next couple of days.

LIVE : Rahul Gandhi, CM Revanth Launches Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Scheme



Historic Legislative Move: Telangana becomes a pioneering state by introducing a dedicated, comprehensive welfare act for gig and platform workers.

Full Data Transparency: Workers finally gain legal rights and direct access to their working data, transaction details, and delivery metrics previously hidden by tech platforms.

Comprehensive Financial Security: Every registered gig worker is granted ₹5 Lakhs in health insurance and ₹5 Lakhs in accidental insurance.

1% Welfare Contribution: A mandatory 1% transaction-based contribution is channeled directly into a dedicated Gig Workers Board to build a secure financial future.

Dignity and Rest Zones: The government is establishing Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones across Hyderabad and other cities so workers can pause, recharge, and rest safely.

Empowerment vs. Exploitation: Rahul Gandhi and Chief Minister Revanth Reddy emphasize shifting the economic paradigm from corporate exploitation to treating gig workers as true economic partners.
